mentions.name: copper-rs
mentions.description: This is a Rust-first robotics runtime and operating system that lets developers target their algorithms for both traditional OSes and embedded targets, with perfectly deterministic replay. It is aimed at builders across the autonomous systems spectrum, including AMRs, humanoids, drones, and self-driving systems.
mentions.audience: Robotics developers across the autonomous systems spectrum (AMRs, humanoids, drones, self-driving), plus Rust enthusiasts curious about robotics
